chunks: Surely they have done with denying; soon will come to them the news of what they were laughing at.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who mocked the Prophet's message in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse highlights the inevitable divine retribution for those who mocked the Prophet's message, a theme particularly resonant in Shia exegesis as a promise of justice for the faithful amidst early persecution. It serves as a warning that the 'news' of their fate will arrive suddenly, validating the truth of the revelation they ridiculed. This assurance underscores the concept of *Haqq al-Yaqin* (certainty of truth) in Shia theological discourse regarding the ultimate victory of the Prophets.
